summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing routine PDMR share dealings: Non-Executive Chair Sir Jonathan Symonds bought 1,500 ordinary shares at 18.8110 pence on 2026-09-18 via the LSE, while four independent non-executive directors purchased a combined 2,997 ADS at $49.8534 each on the NYSE the same day. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are cited. These are ordinary open-market insider purchases, not a special situation; watch for any broader insider-buying or governance signal.
